title: Mochizuki Honami — Leo/need〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

rows.Line: Rehearsal Studio

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Hello! Sorry, I got held up a bit.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: No worries. We've still got to wait for the others anyway.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Oh, is it just me and you?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um... Ichika and Saki should be on their way, right?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'd hope so.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Well, um... They're running late, aren't they?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: They'll get here sooner or later.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line:
I'm sure they will...
Oh, I got a message from Ichika.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: What's it say?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: That she and Saki have just left the school.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: She had a class rep meeting, and Saki had to stay longer for classroom duty.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hmph. Ah, I got one too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's from Saki. She says they're rushing over but it's going to take them at least fifteen minutes to get here.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Fifteen minutes? If we were here all together, it wouldn't feel like very long at all but...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (When it's just me and her, it seems like forever.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (We've made up but it's still so awkward for me to talk to Shiho...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I wonder if she thinks that about me too?)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But we can't just wait in silence...)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Hey.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Y-Yes?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Don't you want to get your kit ready?
Drums take the longest to set up.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Ah, right. I'll do that.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Phew... She spoke to me first.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (No, I can't just leave it like this!)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (I have to work on my attitude too, if we are to stay together.)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Shiho, would you mind if...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Would I mind what?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: If...we did some rhythm pattern practice together?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'd like to make sure I'm following your lead well.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (Does she hate the idea? Hmm, she doesn't look angry.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Don't let me lead.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Wh-Why not?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: We're both doing the rhythmic section, but you don't need to match up what I'm doing.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It would only make our music sound dull.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: It's you setting the tempo for the entire band.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: You're right, of course...

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (That's my problem, always trying to adjust myself to others...)

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: (But I think I can gradually change that.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I'm ready to start playing whenever. How about you?

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: I'm all set up and ready too.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Okay, you start. I'll come in after you.

rows.Speaker: Honami
rows.Line: Sure! Let's do this!
